messages:
zoe_lin: Quick sync — prospect Vaultify wants to kick off a 2-week POC but their security team redlined the KMS/HSM section. They need offline key ceremony support, vendor attestation, and an allowlist. Whats the absolute minimal artifact set to unblock functional tests?

omar_singh: Minimal for POC (to unblock): 1) egress allowlist (CIDR + ports) so our infra can reach their HSM proxy; 2) vendor-signed attestation or FIPS report PDF; 3) one-page key lifecycle matrix (key types, wrapping algs, exportability).

zoe_lin: Procurement: do we require the offline ceremony before any tests? They want to smoke test integrations first.

felix_wu: We can do a staged plan: Stage A = Redwood-managed keys for smoke tests (no ceremony, <48h). Stage B = proxied BYO-HSM with attestation for security tests. Stage C = offline ceremony for Prod. Note perf delta for proxied ops ~7-12ms per crypto call depending on region.

omar_singh: Security add: if they supply HSM attestation it must be vendor-signed and show FIPS 140-2/140-3 or equivalent. For BYO-HSM we also need a statement of non-exportability for CMKs.

zoe_lin: Can we give exact allowlist lines they can paste into their firewall ticket?

omar_singh: Yes, paste below.

omar_singh: ```
34.210.100.12/32:443  # primary HSM proxy endpoint (TLS)
34.210.100.13/32:443  # failover endpoint (TLS)
Outbound ports: 443 TCP (required), 5000-5005 TCP (optional health checks)
Note: allowlist must permit SNI/ALPN-based TLS to our proxy cert.
```

felix_wu: Pricing note: theres a one-time BYO-HSM onboarding fee that covers the ceremony coordinator and dry-run. If they keep BYO in POC theres a small monthly connector charge. I'll attach the SKU in follow-up.

zoe_lin: Timeline ask: if artifacts arrive Mon morning, can we do firewall test Tue and dry-run Wed?

omar_singh: Yes. If attestation + allowlist provided Mon AM we can schedule firewall test Tue, dry-run Wed, sign-off Thu. Ops will require two ceremony observers; include their SSO IDs.

security_bot: Reminder: request key rotation policy example (KEK rotate every 90 days, CMK yearly) and paste sample language into questionnaire.

omar_singh: Pasteable blurb for questionnaire: ```Please attach: (1) vendor-signed HSM attestation cert or FIPS validation report; (2) key lifecycle diagram showing generation, wrapping, storage, rotation frequency; (3) allowlist CIDRs and ports your network team will open; (4) statement whether CMKs are exportable.```

zoe_lin: I'll send the excerpt + allowlist to Vaultify and offer the staged POC plan, timeline, and pricing. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

security_bot: Meeting created: "Vaultify POC KMS readiness" on 2026-05-04T16:00Z. Invite: zoe_lin, omar_singh, felix_wu.
